questions.prompt: If someone called right now saying money was leaving your account and they could only stop it while you stayed on the line, how sure are you that you'd refuse to be rushed?
If a caller pressured you right now, how sure are you that you'd hang up and call your bank back on the number on your card?
How sure are you that you'd refuse to confirm even the last four digits of your account to someone who called you?
If a caller gave you a case number and said their systems had flagged your account, how sure are you that you'd still treat them as unverified?
